scenarios.title: Puente: daily email digest
scenarios.summary: The digest engine groups inbox items and highlights the most urgent billing alert.

steps.detail: The engine pulls the latest inbox state from IMAP.
Billing, AI providers, social, and other items are separated.
Billing issues are moved to the top of the brief.
A compact summary is sent to the client-facing bot.

scenarios.voice: Daily digest ready. Top alert is a billing issue.
next_actions: Draft a reply or schedule follow-up

scenarios.title: Puente: Instagram lead pipeline
scenarios.summary: An Instagram interaction is scored and inserted into the lead pipeline.

steps.detail: A new comment or follower event is detected.
Follower counts, activity, and bio hints are read.
The system assigns a score and classification.
The lead is stored with interaction history.

telegram: Suggested next step: reply or nurture
scenarios.voice: New Instagram lead scored. Suggested next step is reply or nurture.
next_actions: Send a personalized reply if hot

scenarios.title: Puente: WhatsApp Business autoresponse
scenarios.summary: A WhatsApp webhook receives a reservation question and sends a structured response.

steps.detail: Meta sends a new message into the webhook.
The text is classified as greeting, price, reservation, or location.
A reply is built from the response catalog.
The event is appended to the WhatsApp lead log.

scenarios.voice: WhatsApp webhook triggered. Intent detected. Auto-response sent.

scenarios.title: Puente: client demo bridge
scenarios.summary: A task is routed to the correct agent: code, UI, or auto repair.

steps.detail: A task lands in the shared queue.
The bridge decides whether the task is code, UI, or repair.
OpenCode or OpenClaw receives the work.
The result is saved back into the bridge.

scenarios.voice: Bridge task accepted. Routing decided. Result stored.
next_actions: Retry with a smaller task if needed

scenarios.title: Puente: video publish pipeline
scenarios.summary: An image is transformed into a ready-to-post marketing piece.

steps.detail: A source asset enters the training pipeline.
Crops, captions, and preview files are created.
Ready-to-post files are assembled.
The deliverable can now be published or reviewed.

telegram: Suggested next step: review and publish
scenarios.voice: Video asset processed. Ready-to-post output available.
